articles.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six, including surgeon, medics say
articles.summary: Israeli fire killed 11 people in Gaza on Thursday, six of them in the bombing of Nasser hospital in south Gaza early in the day, health officials said, the deadliest single strike since Israel's elections last month. FRANCE 24's Mark Owen speaks with Dr Goher Rahbour, a surgeon working at the Nasser Hospital.

articles.title: Nasser hospital chief worries Israeli attacks will continue, report says

articles.title: Board of Peace says Israeli strike on Gaza hospital ‘underscores’ need for peace plan
Israel kills six in Gaza hospital strike as 9-month-old baby freezes to death
articles.summary: An overnight Israeli air strike on Nasser Hospital in southern Gaza killed at least six Palestinians Thursday, including a teenage boy and a surgeon, medics said. Elsewhere in the devastated Palestinian territory, a nine-month-old baby died from the cold as families flee worsening flooding.

articles.title: Israeli strike on al-Shifa Hospital kills one after six killed in Nasser attack
articles.summary: An Israeli strike targeting Gaza City's al-Shifa Hospital has killed at least one Palestinian near the facility's gate, Wafa reports. The attack comes shortly after an Israeli missile tore through southern Gaza's Nasser Hospital, killing six people, including surgeons and patients. Wafa also reports, citing local sources, that an Israeli drone struck a group of Palestinians in south Khan Younis, while another was fired towards fishing boats off the coast of Gaza City's al-Shati refugee camp…
